caption: The drawing depicts an interior wall featuring a central fireplace with a wooden mantel and a detailed ornamental overmantel. The fireplace is constructed with reddish-brown bricks and includes andirons at the base. The mantle and surrounding woodwork, including the adjacent door and door frame, are rendered in light brown, resembling natural wood grain. The upper part of the wall is decorated with a repeating floral pattern in shades of red, green, and black on a cream background. These patterns include stylized flowers and geometric forms set within rectangular sections separated by vertical borders. Above the fireplace, a panel showcases a more densely patterned section with draped garlands and small floral motifs in similar colors. Below the chair rail, the wall is divided into diamond-shaped sections outlined with red and white striped bands, each diamond containing simple green plant motifs. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the fireplace serving as the central focal point, flanked by matching decorated wall sections and a wooden door on the right side. The top of the wall is finished with a decorative cornice painted in shades of light brown and beige.
title: Stencilled Ballroom
